concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-salesforce-commerce-cloud-sfra-set-up-the-cartridge]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen SFRA cartridge setup guide for test/live keys, storefront and Business Manager configuration, webhook security and scheduled order-status processing, plus optional features and pending CSC payment-link orders.
warnings: Apply this route after the campaign overview worker creates the Adyen Salesforce Commerce Cloud concept; this worker does not propose a competing concept file.
Setup, webhook testing and a pending CSC link do not establish live eligibility, payment success or completed order processing.
Feature support from v20.1.3 applies only where the source marks those features; the page does not pin the installed cartridge version.
